title: Rotate 90 degrees clockwise
prompt:
Return a **new** grid rotated 90° clockwise (the original must be untouched; the result may be non-square). Implement `process(int[][] g)`.

Example: `{{1,2,3},{4,5,6}}` → `{{4,1},{5,2},{6,3}}`.

tests.name: clockwise rotation
tests.hint: out[c][rows - 1 - r] = g[r][c]; dimensions swap (cols x rows).
